title: Market Rickshaw Rush
shortDescription: Dodge obstacles and collect tokens in a colourful offline rickshaw runner.
fullDescription:
Your lane. Your rhythm.

Steer an original auto-rickshaw through a colourful fictional Indian market. Change between three lanes, avoid crates, potholes, delivery carts and parked vehicles, and collect gold delivery tokens.

Choose Easy, Normal or Hard. Speed increases gradually to a cap. Each seeded route includes a planned safe corridor, but you need to steer in time. Distance and tokens build your score; one collision ends the run.

Use swipes or on-screen arrow buttons. Pause whenever you need; resuming uses a three-second countdown. Replay immediately and keep your best score for each difficulty.

Original geometric market artwork, English/Hindi menus, a short tutorial, local saved scores and a reduce-effects setting are bundled for offline play. The prototype is silent.

No account, cloud sync, ads or purchases. This is a fictional arcade game, not a real road map or driving lesson. Look out for new routes in future app updates.
